landing.title: AI Agent Lifecycle Platform
landing.description: Enterprise-grade end-to-end management for AI agents — from knowledge curation and agent design through retrieval, evaluation, and continuous monitoring in production.
landing.tagline: Built for Zava Aviation on Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search — secure, grounded, and observable.

capabilities.title: Agent Design & Build
capabilities.desc: Compose, configure, and deploy purpose-built AI agents tailored to Zava operations and workflows

capabilities.title: Knowledge Management
capabilities.desc: Unify Azure Blob, AI Search indexes, SharePoint, OneLake, and the public web into governed knowledge bases

capabilities.title: Grounded Retrieval
capabilities.desc: Hybrid vector + keyword search with semantic ranking and intent-aware query planning across heterogeneous sources

capabilities.title: Cited Responses
capabilities.desc: Every answer is grounded in source documents with verifiable citations users can open and inspect

capabilities.title: Evaluation & Quality
capabilities.desc: Built-in evaluators, red-team probes, and custom scorers — measure agents before and after every change

capabilities.title: Continuous Monitoring
capabilities.desc: Track agent performance over time with continuous evaluations, traces, and observability dashboards
